written.myAnswer: Interdisciplinary fields combine physics with other areas of study. Examples include biophysics, medical physics, astrophysics, geophysics, climate physics and computational physics.
Complex problems often involve more than one area of knowledge. Interdisciplinary research and collaboration bring together the relevant expertise and methods to understand and solve them.

Major branches of physics include mechanics (motion and forces), heat and thermodynamics (heat and energy transfer), sound and waves, optics (light), electricity and magnetism, and atomic and nuclear physics (the structure and behavior of atoms and nuclei).
Interdisciplinary fields of physics combine physics with other areas of study. Three examples are biophysics, medical physics and astrophysics.
